d.description:
About the Team

We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We work across the B2B ecosystem, including software vendors, technology platforms, and services partners, to help them bring useful AI offerings to market and reach more business customers. Working closely with Sales, Product, and partner programs, we build channels and repeatable go-to-market approaches that expand customer choice and adoption of OpenAI’s models and products.

About the Role

As a B2B Ecosystem Partnerships Lead focused on Partner Growth, you will own the onboarding, activation, and growth of a partner portfolio across OpenAI’s expanding ecosystem programs, including marketplace and Sign in with ChatGPT. This is a hands-on individual contributor role centered on partner management, joint go-to-market execution, and commercial growth. Your portfolio may span ISVs, technology platforms,, and other B2B partners as opportunities evolve. You bring a generalist’s range across relationships, business analysis, deal execution, and operational problem solving. You will build repeatable ways to support a growing partner base and take on selected strategic partnerships.

In this role, you will:

•
Identify and recruit partners across B2B segments for ecosystem programs and joint go-to-market opportunities, prioritizing customer needs, product fit, commercial potential, and readiness to participate and grow.

•
Own day-to-day relationships across your partner portfolio, tailoring engagement to partner needs and opportunity while using repeatable approaches to support a growing partner base.

•
Develop practical business and account plans with partners and Sales, with clear use cases, target customers, owners, milestones, and adoption and commercial goals.

•
Negotiate product and commercial agreements with Legal, Finance, and Product, and lead selected high-touch strategic opportunities in coordination with other partnership owners.

•
Guide partners through program onboarding, technical evaluation, integration, and activation; coordinate enablement and resolve barriers to launch, sustained usage, and expansion.

•
Execute co-selling, joint marketing, and marketplace opportunities with account teams; coordinate with cloud and other ecosystem partners where they help customers buy and deploy solutions.

•
Run regular partner reviews, identify inactive or stalled partners, and execute growth plans that improve participation, product adoption, customer demand, and relationship health.

•
Track onboarding completion, time to activation, active partners, product usage, pipeline contribution, and commercial results with Sales and Operations; use the data to focus effort.

•
Improve onboarding materials, enablement, and partner engagement practices with program and product teams; turn recurring partner issues into fixes that help the broader ecosystem scale.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

•
8+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, partner or account management, enterprise sales, or related commercial roles in technology.

•
Experience managing and growing a portfolio of B2B partners or accounts, with measurable results in onboarding, adoption, retention, or commercial expansion.

•
An understanding of B2B business models, partner channels, and how companies bring products and services to market. Experience with ISVs, technology platforms, services partners, or cloud marketplaces is a plus.

•
Strong business judgment and analytical skills: you can assess partner economics, prioritize a portfolio, and build repeatable processes that help more partners succeed.

•
Ability to work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance, build trust with partner teams, and drive progress without formal authority.

•
A generalist mindset, curiosity about AI, and the ability to learn new products and markets quickly. You can discuss integrations with technical teams and connect capabilities to customer value.

•
Clear communication, sound negotiation skills, and reliable follow-through. You are comfortable balancing relationship building, structured planning, and hands-on problem solving in a changing environment.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

d.description:
About Krea

At Krea, we are building next-generation AI creative tools.

We're dedicated to making AI intuitive and controllable for creatives - our mission is to build tools that empower human creativity, not replace it. We believe AI is a new medium that allows us to express ourselves through various formats - text, images, video, sound, and even 3D. We're building better, smarter, and more controllable tools to harness this medium. We recently took this a step forward with the launch of Krea 2, our first foundation model, built completely from scratch for aesthetic diversity and stylistic control, and with Krea 3 - our new image editing model which recently landed at #4 on every benchmarking arena, only behind ChatGPT 2.5 models and above all Google models.

We've raised over $83M and are backed by world-class investors such as a16z, Bain Capital, and Abstract. We work full-time and in-person at our waterfront office in San Francisco. We care about creativity: our team includes musicians, designers, visual artists, and engineers.

This role

We’re looking for a Partnerships Lead to own our relationships with the companies building the world’s leading AI models, including frontier labs, major tech platforms and emerging research teams in image, video, 3D and audio. You’ll bring these models into our product, often on or before launch day. You’ll negotiate the commercial terms behind them, and you’ll turn each partnership into a launch our community cares about.

The role sits at the intersection of product, partnerships, and creativity. You’ll identify and close strategic partnerships, stay deeply informed about the creative AI ecosystem, and drive partnerships from idea to implementation to launch. You’ll own a portfolio of partners end to end, working closely with leadership on priorities while running the day-to-day independently. This role requires strong product instincts, a real understanding of how generative models are built and served and the ability to manage technically complex partnerships.

What you'll do

•
Build and own partnerships with model providers and AI labs, securing early access, launch-day availability, and co-marketing for new image, video and multimodal models

•
Negotiate commercial terms with model partners, including API pricing, volume commitments, revenue share, rate limits, exclusivity windows and SLAs

•
Track release roadmaps across the model ecosystem so we know what’s coming before it ships, and bring clear recommendations to leadership on which partnerships to pursue and why

•
Plan joint launches with partners: timing, narrative, assets and announcements, working with product, growth and creative

•
Lead negotiations with GPU and cloud providers, managing credits, capacity, pricing, and SLAs

•
Work with finance so model and infrastructure deals match budget, usage and margin

•
Act as the internal owner and long-term relationship holder for each partner, and keep relationships strong across multiple launches

What we're looking for

•
5+ years in partnerships or a related role, with a track record of closing and launching deals

•
Experience working with AI model providers, foundation model labs or major tech platforms, ideally on API or model distribution deals

•
Experience negotiating technical, usage-based agreements (API pricing, capacity, credits, SLAs)

•
Familiarity with generative media, creative tools or the creative AI ecosystem, and a point of view on which models matter and why

•
Strong communication and negotiation skills

•
High ownership, autonomy, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments

Nice to have

•
Experience at an early-stage or high-growth AI company

•
Existing relationships with GPU, cloud, or model providers

•
Prior experience at a creative tools or design software company

•
A technical background or working understanding of model training and inference

What we offer

•
Team: Work alongside a world-class team building the future of AI creative tooling

•
Impact: Significant scope and company-wide impact

•
Competitive compensation: generous salary & equity packages

•
Health & wellness: 100% health & 99% dental/vision insurance premiums covered for employees, health FSA accounts, & long-term disability coverage

•
Time off: Flexible PTO policy

•
Financial planning: 401k with a 4% company-sponsored match

•
Meals in the office: breakfast, lunch, dinner - you name it, we'll cover it

•
Transit: Ubers covered to & from the office

•
Sponsorship: We're open to sponsoring international visas where we can (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H-1B, O-1, E-3).

•
And more!

Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees

d.description:
CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.

You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management

• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up

• Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control

• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation

• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI

• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration

• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

Must-Have Skills

• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
• Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
• Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
• Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills

• 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
• Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
• Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
• Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills

• Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
• Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
• Clear, professional communicator
• Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
• Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas

What we offer

• Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
• Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
• Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
• Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
• Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
• Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
• Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

About Oper

Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.

The fastest growing part of our business is Herman, our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment.

A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium.

Now, we're looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to join our AI Squad and help shape the future of automated mortgages in Europe and beyond.

Your Mission

You'll join the AI Squad, the team building Herman. This is a hands-on, hybrid role spanning AI engineering, product management, and solutions architecture. You'll scope and build working AI prototypes, take them in front of real banks to pressure-test against live mortgage workflows, and work alongside the team to turn these into working Herman features. Requirements

What you'll bring

• 4 to 6 years of experience in software development, with hands-on AI/LLM work.

• Strong with Python and modern AI tooling: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, orchestration, and evaluation.

THE ROLE

You will be the CEO’s right hand in Brazil. You start at his side and end up running the Brazilian market yourself. You shadow Marius in the first customer meetings, then you lead with him in the room, then you run accounts alone. The role is built so that you outgrow it.

dehaze AI identifies chronic disease risks on already existing health data. Thanks to us, our customers, fully integrated health insurers, save ~10% of their yearly health budget. We have signed the first customers in Brazil and plan to grow 10x year over year. Brazil is our most important market today, and the person we hire here will define how dehaze wins it.

Your job is to sell. Health insurers, Unimeds and municipal health secretariats don’t buy from a deck. They buy from a person they trust, after months of in-person meetings, WhatsApp follow-ups and dinners. You are that person. You open the doors the CEO cannot open from Munich, you stay with every deal until it closes, and you turn what you learn in the field into the playbook for how dehaze sells in Brazil.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your core focus is growing customers in Brazil.

•
Open doors: You research, prioritize and reach the right people at health insurers, Unimeds and municipal health secretariats. You identify the internal champions and get us into the room with the decision makers.

•
Lead the room: You are comfortable in front of C-level decision makers. In the first months you shadow Marius in every meeting. Then you lead with him in the room. Then you run the account alone.

•
Push deals over the line: Materials, proposals, follow-ups, contract reviews with legal counsel. You prepare every customer conversation, you own the follow-through, and you don’t let a deal drift.

•
Build trust over long cycles: Enterprise health deals take months. You stay with them: in-person visits, WhatsApp follow-ups, dinners, the small things done right over a long time. You build relationships fast and you keep them.

•
Be on the road: Our customers are spread across Brazil. You travel a lot, and you like it.

•
Be the CEO’s eyes and ears on the ground: You catch what he cannot catch from Munich. You translate not just language, but context. You bring problems early and with options, not late and without.

•
Grow into Country Manager Brazil: Over time you take over management scope: the team, the entity, the market.

WHO YOU ARE

•
2-4 years in a high-output environment. A top consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar) or startup business development. Structured, analytical, strong academic record. The context matters less than the intensity and the trajectory.

•
A real seller, not only an analyst. You are comfortable leading meetings with C-level decision makers and pushing deals over the line. We will test this in the interview with a live customer role-play.

•
A relationship builder. You build trust over long enterprise cycles with health insurers, Unimeds and municipal health secretariats. You are comfortable cold-calling, comfortable being the youngest person in the room, and comfortable staying with a deal for months.

•
Hungry and independent. You don’t wait for instructions. You see a gap, you fill it. You want to move from shadowing to leading to running accounts alone as fast as you can prove you’re ready.

•
Mobile. You travel a lot and you are happy to.

•
Languages: Native-level Portuguese is non-negotiable. Fluent English is required. You will be the voice of dehaze with every customer, regulator and partner in Brazil.

NICE-TO-HAVES

•
Exposure to the health sector: insurers, Unimeds, hospitals, public health, healthtech

•
Experience selling to or working with the public sector in Brazil

•
Familiarity with ANS and LGPD obligations for health data

•
An existing network in the Brazilian healthtech ecosystem

WHY DEHAZE

•
Learn from the best: Work directly alongside serial healthtech entrepreneurs and one of Europe’s leading professors in medical AI. The founding team has built and exited 3 health startups and operated in hyperscaler environments. A shortcut to a decade of learning.

•
Technological frontier: Our proprietary AI builds on a novel architecture unlocking already existing health data. You’ll be at the forefront of technology that fundamentally changes how chronic diseases are identified.

•
Intense speed and impact: We plan to 10x our ARR in the first year. Not a platitude but the actual plan, with a pipeline to back it. You will carry a big part of it.

•
Global scope, real ownership: Technology and science are built in Germany. Our biggest market is Brazil. You drive the decisions that define how we win it.

•
Country-lead trajectory: Competitive salary plus equity participation (VSOP) reflecting the path to Country Manager Brazil. We want you to build this with us, not just work for us.

No cover letter templates. No generic applications. If you can’t articulate why this specific role at this specific company in 5 sentences, we’re probably not the right fit.

ABOUT DEHAZE

dehaze is building proprietary AI infrastructure to identify risks of chronic diseases earlier and more precisely on already existing health data. We save integrated health insurance companies 10% of their health spend and help patients live a healthier life.

Our proprietary technology works where others can’t: on unharmonized already existing health data. Founded by 3 serial entrepreneurs, we are backed by institutional investors and operate across Brazil, with expansion into the US and Europe planned.

Who We Are

4M Analytics is building the first Subsurface World Model: an AI platform that uses visual reasoning and large-scale data fusion to turn the undocumented world beneath our streets into one living, intelligent map. We make reliable utility data accessible to the construction industry, government agencies, and utility owners, and we are changing how infrastructure is understood and protected.

We are Series C, backed by Insight Partners, Viola, and F2, with 120 people across Tel Aviv and Austin, Texas. The problem is massive, the momentum is real, and we are moving fast.

The Opportunity

Joining the Utility Owners Business Unit means you are at the forefront of a mission-critical expansion. You will have a direct impact on how major utilities manage their subsurface risk, preventing catastrophic damage and saving lives. This role offers a unique career trajectory: as a foundational hire, you have the opportunity to grow into owning broader product areas, leading new segments, or shaping our entire AI-product strategy as the business scales.

Over the past several years, 4M built significant business around Departments of Transportation (DOTs) — we now serve 10-12 DOT customers, and we did it deliberately: hire someone close to the customer, learn the workflow cold, and build the product the market actually needed. We're now applying that same intentional playbook to a new frontier: the Utility Owners segment.

This is a hybrid, next-gen role, combining classic Product Management with hands-on AI Building. You'll spend your time close to utility owner customers, absorb their workflows and pain points first-hand, and turn what you learn directly into working software — prototyping with modern AI tools, validating with real customers, then handing proven concepts to engineering to take to production fast. You're the connective tissue between the market and the product, fluent in the language of both the customer and the developer.

This is a deliberate, foundational hire. You'll report directly to the VP Product, work hand in hand with Engineering, and have the mandate to define what winning the Utility Owners segment looks like.

What You'll Do

•
Live in the market. Run continuous discovery with Utility Owner customers — calls, site visits, workflow shadowing — to build a first-hand understanding of their pain points, workflows, and business drivers.

•
Find the patterns, the opportunity, and turn it into a product. Think like a founder to map the market landscape, identify where the biggest pain points and budget reside, and synthesize customer feedback into a scalable product roadmap and clear productization strategy.

•
Define the strategy for winning the segment. Own the "where to play / how to win" for Utility Owners — target sub-segments, positioning, and the wedge that gets us in — in close partnership with the CEO, Chief Growth Officer, and engineering leadership.

•
Build beautiful products, fast. Use AI-native tools (Claude,Cursor etc.) to go from idea to a working, demonstrable Alpha in days or even hours — and if the customer validates it, Engineering makes it production-viable.

•
Bridge market and engineering. Be the connective layer between customers and the engineering pod. Translate validated concepts into something engineering can take to production, and stay involved through the handoff.

•
Own the outcome, commercially. Define what success looks like for the segment in business terms — adoption, revenue, land-and-expand — and track progress against it, partnering with Growth on how we take it to market.

•
Master a regulated, technical domain fast. No utility expertise required, but you'll rapidly get fluent in civil infrastructure, damage-prevention, and the regulatory landscape well enough to be credible with customers.

What You Bring

•
Relevant educational background (BA/BS/BE/MBA). This could be in business, computer science, or even architecture/industrial engineering.

•
7+ years of experience spanning reputed management consulting and/or product management at a B2B SaaS, data, or AI-native company.

•
A genuine builder's mentality: you can independently design, prototype, and ship working software using modern AI tools. For example, you might have a portfolio showcasing a deployed web app built with AI. You understand what the AI is generating well enough to reason about it and correct it - this is required, not solely dependent on "vibe coding." Prior engineering experience or a technical degree is a strong plus, not a must.

•
Comfortable operating in a 0-to-1, forward-deployed capacity - shaping a brand-new product and market directly with executives and customers, without an existing playbook to lean on.

•
The "Strategic Builder" balance: We exceptionally value the intersection of strategic consulting instincts - the ability to decompose complex business problems - and the gritty, hands-on skills required to build the solution yourself.

•
Sharp, credible communicator who translates cleanly between customer needs and engineering, and who's comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with the CEO and Chief Growth Officer as well as in front of customers.

•
Flexibility to travel on-site to customers as needed, as well as to our Austin, TX offices.

﻿AI-First Mindset

﻿We're building an AI-first product culture, and we're looking for product builders who are genuinely excited about working this way. This role is for you if you use tools like Claude daily to prototype, iterate, and demo functioning software yourself.

Standout Attributes

•
Candidates who pair top-tier consultancy experience along with hands-on product experience are an exceptionally strong fit.

•
Your own side project, startup, or open-source work built substantially with AI tools — don't just tell us, show us!

•
Prior exposure to utility infrastructure, civil/damage-prevention work, or the regulatory landscape (permitting, compliance, fines, risk on infrastructure projects).

You'll own how TraceRoot talks to developers. Everything we publish — the posts, the launches, the docs that read like arguments, the demos — is yours to write and ship. Our growth today comes from developers who found the repo, installed it, and told someone. Your job is to make far more of them find it.

This is a writing job for someone who likes software. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be the kind of person who installs the tool, breaks it on purpose, and finds the story in what happened. The best thing we can publish is a developer explaining something true and specific about debugging agents — that's the bar, and you'll hit it weekly.

We move fast, debate hard, and execute even harder. You'll work in person with me at least 3 days a week. You won't own everything in one summer — you'll pick a channel with me and own that number end-to-end. There's a path into our full-time Founding GTM role; be aware that role adds calls and pipeline to the writing, so converting means growing into the commercial half too.

What You’ll Do

•
Write the things developers actually read — technical deep dives, postmortems, and docs-as-marketing about what breaks in production agents and how to see it. Not thought leadership; specific, useful writing with real traces and real code in it.

•
Run the launches — Hacker News, Product Hunt, Reddit, and X. You'll write the post, prepare the assets, be in the comments answering people all day, and do the follow-through that turns a spike into retained users.

•
Own SEO and GEO — comparison pages and problem-first pages that rank, and getting TraceRoot cited by ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity when someone asks how to debug an agent. This is a compounding channel and it will be substantially yours.

•
Show the product, don't describe it — short demo clips, screenshots, and walkthroughs that make the thing obvious in ten seconds; plus dev-influencer collabs, hackathons, and a Discord where people actually get answers.

•
Know what worked — track which post, page, or launch actually drove installs and traces, and say so honestly, including when the answer is "none of them." We'll set you up in PostHog; you don't need to build it.

Requirements

•
You write, and people read it: a blog, a newsletter, a thread that went somewhere, docs, a README people thanked you for. Any of it counts. Send it.

•
Technically curious enough to be credible: you can install TraceRoot yourself with Claude Code, read a stack trace, and explain what happened without a hand-holder. You do not need to write production code for this role.

•
You have taste in developer content: you know why a post lands on Hacker News and why marketing copy gets torn apart there, because you read those threads for fun.

•
Fast and prolific: you'd rather ship six pieces and learn which two worked than polish one for a month.

•
Strong sense of ownership and bias for action: you own outcomes, not tasks, and you make things happen without waiting for a roadmap or a content calendar.

•
You've done this unpaid already: grown an open-source project, run a technical blog or newsletter, or written docs for something people use.

•
In the community: you're around people building agents, and you know who the voices are.

•
LLMs as a tool, not a topic: you use model APIs to research, draft, and repurpose — and you know exactly where that stops working and you have to write it yourself.

Send two things:

•
Two sentences on the first experiment you'd run to get more agent-building teams onto TraceRoot.

•
A link to something you built — a repo, a script, a scraper, a landing page, a Discord bot, an outreach system. It does not need to be a growth project and it does not need to be impressive; we just want to see you ship.

About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We’re looking for a Content & Campaign Operations Intern to keep a high-volume content engine moving, from the first conversation to the final video. You’ll work with our marketing team on influencer videos and customer stories, and make sure creators and customers always know what happens next.

This is a hands-on, in-office role at our Delhi HQ. It suits someone who enjoys content and coordination equally and likes closing loops.

The Job

•
Find the right creators: Shortlist influencers whose content and audience fit Atlys, and help shape a storyline for each one that feels true to them.

•
Drive videos to go-live: Coordinate with our agency for each creator through the shoot, edit and go-live stages, working towards 180 videos live every month.

•
Pitch customer stories: Reach out to travellers who got their visas through Atlys, explain the testimonial project and pitch the perks, including hotel vouchers and other Atlys benefits.

•
Run testimonial shoots: Bring interested customers on board and coordinate shoots at their location or the Atlys office with the customer, agency and internal team.

•
Close every loop: Track feedback, revisions, follow-ups, confirmations and deadlines across both projects, so no conversation gets lost and every video moves towards going live.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

•
Take ownership, follow up without being chased, and spot delays and blockers before they slow things down.

•
Write clear, engaging, grammatically sound copy, whether it’s a message, a content brief or a basic script.

•
Speak articulately and are comfortable talking to people on calls and in person.

•
Know what makes a creator, angle or storyline interesting, and stay on top of internet trends, memes and pop culture.

•
Can manage many conversations at once, keep trackers up to date and hold deadlines.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

•
Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

•
Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

•
A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

•
Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

•
Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

•
Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

•
Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

•
An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

About LiveFlow

LiveFlow is on a mission to redefine how businesses manage their finances.

We have raised over $21M from top-tier investors including: YC, YC Continuity, Valar Seedcamp, WndrCo, Moonfire, Bradley Horowitz (VP Product, Google) and more.

We are helping thousands of companies to streamline their financial workflows and we have hundreds of 5/5 ratings on G2.

Our founding team previously worked at Europe's fastest growing fintech, Revolut.

About the role

We're hiring a Field Marketing Lead to own field marketing end-to-end. One of our core verticals is Restaurant & Hospitality businesses, and your mission is to get every restaurant owner in New York City to know about us.

Here’s what you’ll do

•
Lead, run and execute our door-to-door launch across New York.

•
Hire and motivate a team of 10–20 brand ambassadors who will visit restaurants in person.

•
Build an exceptional team culture among the brand ambassadors.

•
Host owner dinners, chef roundtables and industry events.

•
Work with sales to generate a high-quality pipeline and ensure high conversion.

•
Team up with restaurant groups, suppliers, POS companies and creators to get us warm intros and get owners talking.

What we’re looking for in you

You have experience leading field marketing teams.

•
You have a good network in New York City and can make things happen quickly.

•
People are drawn to you and follow you, and you can motivate a team of ambassadors.

•
It’s a big bonus if you’ve worked in restaurants or hospitality, or led field marketing for a restaurant or hospitality business.

Why join us

•
You get the autonomy to run the show. We expect you to be self-guided and able to work very autonomously.

•
We work hard to stretch you and expand your capabilities by giving you challenging goals and missions.

Location & compensation

•
New York City.

•
Fully in person, with a lot of flexibility on where you work during the day, as you’ll spend most of your days outside the office.

•
$100,000–$130,000 per year.

We’re hiring a Program Manager to build and run our partner network. You will turn an early program into a reliable operation: recruit and onboard partners, coordinate agreements and payments, manage external service providers, support local events and marketing, review service quality, and improve the program as we learn.

This partner network will be on the ground in communities helping people–from small businesses, non-profits, and community organizations–experience concrete benefits from our technology. They will set up useful workflows, learn OpenAI tools and become more confident, independent users.

You should be as comfortable helping a partner resolve an onboarding issue as you are designing the systems that prevent it from happening again. About the Team
OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their organization. The team comprises Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals who collaborate to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the Role

Our Government Sales team has a unique mission to help the U.S. Intelligence Community understand the transformative impact that highly capable AI models can bring to its most critical missions. This role combines technical understanding, strategic vision, relationship management, and value-driven sales strategy tailored specifically to Intelligence Community customers.

You’ll drive key opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation through deployment and expansion. You’ll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, solution strategists, and cross-functional partners to help Intelligence Community customers advance their missions through AI.

This role is based in Washington, D.C. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In addition, this role requires frequent on-site engagement at customer and partner facilities across the Washington, D.C./Northern Virginia corridor, including classified environments.

In this role, you will:

•
Manage a focused set of key U.S. Intelligence Community accounts, developing and executing comprehensive account strategies.

•
Lead Intelligence Community customers through their AI adoption journey, from initial consideration through successful deployment and expansion.

•
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, mission owners, technical stakeholders, acquisition professionals, and other decision-makers across the Intelligence Community.

•
Partner with Solutions and Research Engineering teams to design and execute complex customer programs and deployments.

•
Develop and execute capture and co-sell strategies with federal systems integrators and specialized mission partners to position OpenAI in multi-year programs of record.

•
Align opportunity planning and deal strategy to MIP and NIP funding cycles, classified contract vehicles, appropriations timing, and extended approval chains.

•
Work with cleared technical teams to demonstrate value across cloud, hybrid, on-premises, and air-gapped environments and translate technical fit into mission outcomes.

•
Own and manage an Intelligence Community consumption revenue target.

•
Develop pipeline, lead complex deal strategies, and drive opportunities through the full sales cycle.

•
Oversee revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and account reporting.

•

About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

Our partners - card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs - are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.

The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care. There's no playbook.

The Job

•
Own a portfolio of live partnerships - deepen them and grow what they generate.

•
Take 4–5 new partnerships live every month, with most partnerships going from first conversation to live in about two weeks.

•
Run longer-term partnerships that may span months, multiple geographies, and involve product, legal and procurement teams.

•
Write cold outreach that gets a reply from someone senior.

•
Build the commercial construct, not just the relationship.

•
Drive go-live across product, operations and legal to ensure partnerships move from conversation to execution.

•
Own the numbers on every relationship you hold and stay accountable for the outcomes of your partnerships.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

•
Have 0–2 years of experience. Exceptional fresh graduates are welcome.

•
Have no degree or institution filter - we care about what you can do, not where you studied.

•
Write exceptionally well. This is the highest-weighted skill for this role.

•
Can reason from first principles and build a deal structure when there is no precedent to follow.

•
Can be the most junior person in the room and still run the conversation confidently.

•
Have strong commercial judgement and can think about what creates value for both Atlys and the partner.

•
Are patient, input-driven and comfortable with outcomes that can be lumpy while the work remains consistent every day.

•
Take strong ownership and are comfortable building something without a predefined playbook.

•
Communicate exceptionally well and can build relationships with senior decision-makers.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

•
Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

•
Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

•
A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

•
Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

•
Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

•
Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

•
Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

•
An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•

We’re hiring a Sales Execution & NA Enablement Lead to raise how our enterprise sellers plan, pursue, and win complex, technical deals. This is not a traditional training role. You’ll set the standard for what great enterprise selling looks like, turn it into artifacts and operating rhythms, and make sure sellers and managers actually use it.

•
Own enterprise sales execution: Build and operationalize the critical artifacts that drive excellent sales execution.

Enable sellers to win technical enterprise deals: Coach reps to build business cases with champions, read 10-Ks, and connect ElevenLabs capabilities to measurable outcomes for technical and economic buyers.

Facilitate globally: Lead highly engaging, practical sales execution sessions, not just build the programs behind them.

•
Manage the coaching and operating rhythm: Embed selling standards and artifacts into how managers inspect deals and coach sellers.

•
Build the foundation for a vertical selling motion: Lay the groundwork for vertical selling, which is becoming a global priority, not just an NA need.

•
Execute in an AI-native way: Use AI to scale coaching, practice, and reinforcement, going beyond general AI fluency.

•
10+ years experience in enterprise sales leadership and enablement experience, ideally in an AI-native or developer-focused company

•
Excellence building and operationalizing value-selling artifacts across sales org with measurable results

•
Experience with MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar methodologies, and the judgment to adapt them

•
Experience enabling frontline sales managers and building strong coaching methodologies

•
AI fluency, and comfort building in a fast-growing environment where the operating model is still taking shape

Enough technical depth to credibly support sellers selling to developers and technical buyers

•
Proven cross-functional influence across Sales, RevOps, PMM, Product, and FDE teams

Bonus: Experience working in voice AI

Location
